page.overview:
Who is Battle Beast?

Thokk, better known as Battle Beast, is a supporting character in Invincible, debuting from Season 1 and onwards.

He is a legendary Dornian warrior driven by an insatiable desire to find worthy opponents who can grant him a glorious death in battle. His unyielding thirst for conflict led him to Earth, where he met, fought, and bested Invincible and the Guardians of the Globe. In the end, he deemed them inadequate and departed the planet. Not long after, he was imprisoned by the Viltrum Empire, but nearly a year later, he was freed by Allen the Alien to unite with the Coalition of Planets in their effort to finally defeat the Empire so he might battle the strongest Viltrumites.

Battle Beast is a tall, powerfully built humanoid alien with striking leonine features. His body is covered in white fur, and his mane is styled into French braids along both sides of his head. He wears a black leotard with red shoulder pads, black arm warmers, red toeless boots, and matching gloves. A distinctive belt with a red-and-yellow checkered pattern completes his appearance. He is likely a member of the same species as Mokk, as both share similar feline, lion-like characteristics.

Battle Beast is a fierce, relentless leonine warrior driven by an insatiable, exhilarating thirst for worthy combat. Proud and arrogant, he views most inferior opponents as beneath his level, often showing disdain and cruelty toward those he deems weak or unworthy of facing his raw might. His brutal and ferociously efficient fighting style displays superior strength and tactical prowess, intimidating even the most formidable foes. Battle Beast’s passion for battle borders on being obsessive, even nigh suicidal, as he yearns for a true warrior’s death at the hands of a worthy, superior adversary.

Also known as: Battle Beast warrior.
